abbott_smith_html:
οὕτως, rarely (Bl., §5, 4; WH, App., 146f.) οὕτω, adv.
(οὗτος), [in LXX chiefly for כֵּן ;]
in this way, so, thus;
__1. referring to what precedes: Mat.5:16 6:30, Mrk.10:43 14:59, Luk.1:25 2:48 15:7, Jhn.3:8, Rom.1:15, 1Co.8:12, al.; οὕτως καί, Mat.17:12, Mrk.13:29, al.; pleonastically, resuming a ptcp. (cl.; see Bl., §74, 6), Act.20:11 27:17.
__2. Referring to what follows: Mat.1:18 6:9, Luk.19:31, Jhn.21:1, 1Pe.2:15; bef. quotations from OT, Mat.2:5, Act.7:6, 1Co.15:45, Heb.4:4.
__3. C. adj. (marking intensity): Heb.12:21, Rev.16:18; similarly with adv., Gal.1:6 (cl.).
__4. As a predicate (Bl., §76, 1): Mat.1:18 9:33, Mrk.2:1, 2 4:26, Rom.4:18 9:20, I Pe 2:15; οὕ ἔχειν (Lat. sic or ita se habere), Act.7:1, al.; ἐκαθέζετο (as he was, without delay or preparation), Jhn.4:6.
__5. In comparison, with correlative adv.: καθάπερ . . . οὕ., Rom.12:4, 5 al.; καθὼς . . . οὕ., Luk.11:30, al.; οὕ. . . . καθώς, Luk.24:24, al.; ὡς . . . οὕ., Rom.5:15, al.; οὕ . . . ὡς, Mrk.4:26, al; ὥσπερ . . . οὕ., Mat.12:40, al.; οὕ. . . . οὕ., 1Co.7:7.
(AS)

occurrences.kjv: But this I confess unto thee, that after the way which they call heresy, so worship I the God of my fathers, believing all things which are written in the law and in the prophets:

occurrences.bsb: After hoisting it up, the crew used ropes to undergird the ship. And fearing that they would run aground on the sandbars of Syrtis, they lowered the sea anchor and were driven along.
occurrences.kjv: Which when they had taken up, they used helps, undergirding the ship; and, fearing lest they should fall into the quicksands, strake sail, and so were driven.

occurrences.bsb: So take courage, men, for I believe God that it will happen just as He told me.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.

occurrences.bsb: The rest were to follow on planks and various parts of the ship. In this way everyone was brought safely to land.
occurrences.kjv: And the rest, some on boards, and some on broken pieces of the ship. And so it came to pass, that they escaped all safe to land.

occurrences.bsb: There we found some brothers who invited us to spend the week with them. And so we came to Rome.
occurrences.kjv: Where we found brethren, and were desired to tarry with them seven days: and so we went toward Rome.

occurrences.bsb: That is why I am so eager to preach the gospel also to you who are in Rome.
occurrences.kjv: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.

occurrences.bsb: Against all hope, Abraham in hope believed and so became the father of many nations, just as he had been told, “So shall your offspring be.”
occurrences.kjv: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations; according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, just as sin entered the world through one man, and death through sin, so also death was passed on to all men, because all sinned.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

occurrences.bsb: But the gift is not like the trespass. For if the many died by the trespass of the one man, how much more did God’s grace and the gift that came by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many!
occurrences.kjv: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.

occurrences.bsb: So then, just as one trespass brought condemnation for all men, so also one act of righteousness brought justification and life for all men.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.

occurrences.bsb: For just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the one man the many will be made righteous.
occurrences.kjv: For as by one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.

occurrences.bsb: so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness to bring eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.

occurrences.bsb: We were therefore buried with Him through baptism into death, in order that, just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, we too may walk in newness of life.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.

occurrences.bsb: So you too must count yourselves dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.

occurrences.bsb: I am speaking in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh. Just as you used to offer the parts of your body in slavery to impurity and to escalating wickedness, so now offer them in slavery to righteousness leading to holiness.
occurrences.kjv: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.

occurrences.bsb: But who are you, O man, to talk back to God? Shall what is formed say to Him who formed it, “Why did You make me like this?”
occurrences.kjv: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?

occurrences.bsb: But the righteousness that is by faith says: “Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down)
occurrences.kjv: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)

occurrences.bsb: In the same way, at the present time there is a remnant chosen by grace.
occurrences.kjv: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

occurrences.bsb: And so all Israel will be saved, as it is written: “The Deliverer will come from Zion; He will remove godlessness from Jacob.
occurrences.kjv: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:

occurrences.bsb: so they too have now disobeyed, in order that they too may now receive mercy through the mercy shown to you.
occurrences.kjv: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.

occurrences.bsb: so in Christ we who are many are one body, and each member belongs to one another.
occurrences.kjv: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.

occurrences.bsb: In this way I have aspired to preach the gospel where Christ was not known, so that I would not be building on someone else’s foundation.
occurrences.kjv: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man’s foundation:

occurrences.bsb: For who among men knows the thoughts of man except his own spirit within him? So too, no one knows the thoughts of God except the Spirit of God.
occurrences.kjv: For what man knoweth the things of a man, save the spirit of man which is in him? even so the things of God knoweth no man, but the Spirit of God.

occurrences.bsb: If it is burned up, he will suffer loss. He himself will be saved, but only as if through the flames.
occurrences.kjv: If any man’s work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.

occurrences.bsb: So then, men ought to regard us as servants of Christ and stewards of the mysteries of God.
occurrences.kjv: Let a man so account of us, as of the ministers of Christ, and stewards of the mysteries of God.

occurrences.bsb: Although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit, and I have already pronounced judgment on the one who did this, just as if I were present.
occurrences.kjv: For I verily, as absent in body, but present in spirit, have judged already, as though I were present, concerning him that hath so done this deed,

occurrences.bsb: I say this to your shame. Is there really no one among you wise enough to arbitrate between his brothers?
occurrences.kjv: I speak to your shame. Is it so, that there is not a wise man among you? no, not one that shall be able to judge between his brethren?

occurrences.bsb: I wish that all men were as I am. But each man has his own gift from God; one has this gift, another has that.
occurrences.kjv: For I would that all men were even as I myself. But every man hath his proper gift of God, one after this manner, and another after that.

occurrences.bsb: Regardless, each one should lead the life that the Lord has assigned to him and to which God has called him. This is what I prescribe in all the churches.
occurrences.kjv: But as God hath distributed to every man, as the Lord hath called every one, so let him walk. And so ordain I in all churches.

occurrences.bsb: Because of the present crisis, I think it is good for a man to remain as he is.
occurrences.kjv: I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress, I say, that it is good for a man so to be.

occurrences.bsb: However, if someone thinks he is acting inappropriately toward his betrothed, and if she is beyond her youth and they ought to marry, let him do as he wishes; he is not sinning; they should get married.
occurrences.kjv: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sinneth not: let them marry.

occurrences.bsb: In my judgment, however, she is happier if she remains as she is. And I think that I too have the Spirit of God.
occurrences.kjv: But she is happier if she so abide, after my judgment: and I think also that I have the Spirit of God.

occurrences.bsb: By sinning against your brothers in this way and wounding their weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
occurrences.kjv: But when ye sin so against the brethren, and wound their weak conscience, ye sin against Christ.

occurrences.bsb: In the same way, the Lord has prescribed that those who preach the gospel should receive their living from the gospel.
occurrences.kjv: Even so hath the Lord ordained that they which preach the gospel should live of the gospel.

occurrences.bsb: But I have not used any of these rights. And I am not writing this to suggest that something be done for me. Indeed, I would rather die than let anyone nullify my boast.
occurrences.kjv: But I have used none of these things: neither have I written these things, that it should be so done unto me: for it were better for me to die, than that any man should make my glorying void.

occurrences.bsb: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one receives the prize? Run in such a way as to take the prize.
occurrences.kjv: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore I do not run aimlessly; I do not fight like I am beating the air.
occurrences.kjv: I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:

occurrences.bsb: For just as woman came from man, so also man is born of woman. But everything comes from God.
occurrences.kjv: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.

occurrences.bsb: Each one must examine himself before he eats of the bread and drinks of the cup.
occurrences.kjv: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.

occurrences.bsb: The body is a unit, though it is composed of many parts. And although its parts are many, they all form one body. So it is with Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.

occurrences.bsb: So it is with you. Unless you speak intelligible words with your tongue, how will anyone know what you are saying? You will just be speaking into the air.
occurrences.kjv: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.

occurrences.bsb: It is the same with you. Since you are eager to have spiritual gifts, strive to excel in gifts that build up the church.
occurrences.kjv: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.

occurrences.bsb: It is written in the Law: “By strange tongues and foreign lips I will speak to this people, but even then they will not listen to Me, says the Lord.”
occurrences.kjv: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: and the secrets of his heart will be made known. So he will fall facedown and worship God, proclaiming, “God is truly among you!”
occurrences.kjv: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.

occurrences.bsb: Whether, then, it was I or they, this is what we preach, and this is what you believed.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.

occurrences.bsb: For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.
occurrences.kjv: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.

occurrences.bsb: So will it be with the resurrection of the dead: What is sown is perishable; it is raised imperishable.
occurrences.kjv: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:

occurrences.bsb: So it is written: “The first man Adam became a living being”; the last Adam a life-giving spirit.
occurrences.kjv: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.

occurrences.bsb: Now about the collection for the saints, you are to do as I directed the churches of Galatia:
occurrences.kjv: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.

occurrences.bsb: For just as the sufferings of Christ overflow to us, so also through Christ our comfort overflows.
occurrences.kjv: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.

occurrences.bsb: And our hope for you is sure, because we know that just as you share in our sufferings, so also you will share in our comfort.
occurrences.kjv: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.

occurrences.bsb: Indeed, I was not embarrassed by anything I had boasted to him about you. But just as everything we said to you was true, so our boasting to Titus has proved to be true as well.
occurrences.kjv: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.

occurrences.bsb: So we urged Titus to help complete your act of grace, just as he had started it.
occurrences.kjv: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.

occurrences.bsb: Now finish the work, so that you may complete it with the same eager desire, according to your means.
occurrences.kjv: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.

occurrences.bsb: So I thought it necessary to urge the brothers to visit you beforehand and make arrangements for the generous gift you had promised. This way, your gift will be prepared generously and not begrudgingly.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.

occurrences.bsb: You are looking at outward appearances. If anyone is confident that he belongs to Christ, he should remind himself that we belong to Christ just as much as he does.
occurrences.kjv: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ’s, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ’s, even so are we Christ’s.

occurrences.bsb: I am amazed how quickly you are deserting the One who called you by the grace of Christ and are turning to a different gospel—
occurrences.kjv: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:

occurrences.bsb: Are you so foolish? After starting in the Spirit, are you now finishing in the flesh?
occurrences.kjv: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?

occurrences.bsb: So also, when we were children, we were enslaved under the basic principles of the world.
occurrences.kjv: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:

occurrences.bsb: At that time, however, the son born by the flesh persecuted the son born by the Spirit. It is the same now.
occurrences.kjv: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.

occurrences.bsb: Carry one another’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: But this is not the way you came to know Christ.
occurrences.kjv: But ye have not so learned Christ;

occurrences.bsb: Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.

occurrences.bsb: In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.
occurrences.kjv: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.

occurrences.bsb: Nevertheless, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.

occurrences.bsb: Join one another in following my example, brothers, and carefully observe those who walk according to the pattern we set for you.
occurrences.kjv: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, my brothers, whom I love and long for, my joy and crown, that is how you must stand firm in the Lord, my beloved.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.

occurrences.bsb: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
occurrences.kjv: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

occurrences.bsb: Instead, we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, not in order to please men but God, who examines our hearts.
occurrences.kjv: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.

occurrences.bsb: We cared so deeply that we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God, but our own lives as well. That is how beloved you have become to us.
occurrences.kjv: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.

occurrences.bsb: For since we believe that Jesus died and rose again, we also believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in Him.
occurrences.kjv: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.

occurrences.bsb: After that, we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will always be with the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: For you are fully aware that the Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
occurrences.kjv: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.

occurrences.bsb: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul. This is my mark in every letter; it is the way I write.
occurrences.kjv: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.

occurrences.bsb: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these men oppose the truth. They are depraved in mind and disqualified from the faith.
occurrences.kjv: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.

occurrences.bsb: For somewhere He has spoken about the seventh day in this manner: “And on the seventh day God rested from all His works.”
occurrences.kjv: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.

occurrences.bsb: That is why he is obligated to offer sacrifices for his own sins, as well as for the sins of the people.
occurrences.kjv: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.

occurrences.bsb: So also Christ did not take upon Himself the glory of becoming a high priest, but He was called by the One who said to Him: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.”
occurrences.kjv: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.

occurrences.bsb: Even though we speak like this, beloved, we are convinced of better things in your case—things that accompany salvation.
occurrences.kjv: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.

occurrences.bsb: And so Abraham, after waiting patiently, obtained the promise.
occurrences.kjv: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

occurrences.bsb: When everything had been prepared in this way, the priests entered regularly into the first room to perform their sacred duties.
occurrences.kjv: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God.

occurrences.bsb: so also Christ was offered once to bear the sins of many; and He will appear a second time, not to bear sin, but to bring salvation to those who eagerly await Him.
occurrences.kjv: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.

occurrences.bsb: Sometimes you were publicly exposed to ridicule and persecution; at other times you were partners with those who were so treated.
occurrences.kjv: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.

occurrences.bsb: The sight was so terrifying that even Moses said, “I am trembling with fear.”
occurrences.kjv: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)

occurrences.bsb: For the sun rises with scorching heat and withers the plant; its flower falls and its beauty is lost. So too, the rich man will fade away in the midst of his pursuits.
occurrences.kjv: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.

occurrences.bsb: Speak and act as those who are going to be judged by the law that gives freedom.
occurrences.kjv: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.

occurrences.bsb: So too, faith by itself, if it does not result in action, is dead.
occurrences.kjv: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.

occurrences.bsb: As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead.
occurrences.kjv: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.

occurrences.bsb: In the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it boasts of great things. Consider how small a spark sets a great forest ablaze.
occurrences.kjv: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!

occurrences.bsb: Out of the same mouth come blessing and cursing. My brothers, this should not be!
occurrences.kjv: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.

occurrences.bsb: For it is God’s will that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish men.
occurrences.kjv: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:

occurrences.bsb: For this is how the holy women of the past adorned themselves. They put their hope in God and were submissive to their husbands,
occurrences.kjv: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:

occurrences.bsb: and you will receive a lavish reception into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: “Where is the promise of His coming?” they will ask. “Ever since our fathers fell asleep, everything continues as it has from the beginning of creation.”
occurrences.kjv: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.

occurrences.bsb: Since everything will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people ought you to be? You ought to conduct yourselves in holiness and godliness
occurrences.kjv: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.

occurrences.bsb: In the same way, some of you also hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
occurrences.kjv: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.

occurrences.bsb: Like them, he who overcomes will be dressed in white. And I will never blot out his name from the Book of Life, but I will confess his name before My Father and His angels.
occurrences.kjv: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

occurrences.bsb: So because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I am about to vomit you out of My mouth!
occurrences.kjv: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.

occurrences.bsb: Now the horses and riders in my vision looked like this: The riders had breastplates the colors of fire, sapphire, and sulfur. The heads of the horses were like the heads of lions, and out of their mouths proceeded fire, smoke, and sulfur.
occurrences.kjv: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone wants to harm them, fire proceeds from their mouths and devours their enemies. In this way, anyone who wants to harm them must be killed.
occurrences.kjv: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth, and devoureth their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.

occurrences.bsb: And there were flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder, and a great earthquake the likes of which had not occurred since men were upon the earth—so mighty was the great quake.
occurrences.kjv: And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake, and so great.

occurrences.bsb: Then a mighty angel picked up a stone the size of a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying: “With such violence the great city of Babylon will be cast down, never to be seen again.
occurrences.kjv: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.
